decisions.reason: The product shows clear customer value with a quantified saving claim, fits the firm's modular environmental-technology direction, and in a growing firm with slack this performance is above aspiration and supports retention.

Although no explicit performance metric is shown, it remained on its own page for two years, is close to the core offer, and a growing machinery firm would usually keep such a product unless results clearly fell below aspiration.
The product has both a strong quantified outcome and a named customer reference after more than a year in use, indicating performance comfortably meeting aspirations and making withdrawal unlikely.
As a 2024 launch in a core product area, its results are still uncertain, but the firm's growth, R&D orientation and available slack make continued market presence more likely than early termination.

This recent extension builds on the established portfolio and supports the firm's strategic move toward broader modular processing solutions, so management would likely allow more time for learning before considering a drop.
